Introduction

A story about the fate of a domain military scientific institute studying phase space in the burning sector.

The Domain Phase Lab is a High-Tech faction centered around beam weaponry, lightning, motes, and surprisingly, phase technology.

The mod focuses on story content revolving around the faction. There are several quests that rewards the players with limited experimental weaponry and ships.

The Phase Labs are by nature pacifists who are more than eager to get to know others better.

Ships

Ships

Note: Only a few of the many ships are being shown. Ships are still subject to change.

DPL's ship designs mainly focuses around high-tech ships with a heavy focus towards energy weapons, as well as carriers to provide long-range support. Naturally, the Phase Labs also offers a wide variety of Phase Ships, some of which employs the use of certain gimmicks rather than providing any firepower themselves.
That said, the faction does not mainly rely on Phase Ships. The Phase Labs pursue the field of study of the many properties of P-Space, and their research bears fruit in the forms of weapons and systems.

Weapons

Weapons
The Bombardon (Built-in weapon for the Sarrusophone-class Capital), a long-range 'sniper' railgun.

The Phase Charge Lance, a common large beam weapon that creates motes upon impact.

The Lightning Projector, shoot powerful arcs of EMP lightning with rechargable ammo!

The Phase Rupture LPC, manipulate literal P-Space Phenomena as your tools of war.

...There are even some powerful prototype hulls and weapons out there, but they won't be so easy to obtain...

Lore

Lore
Originally a classified institute belonging to the Domain, The Phase Lab's main role is to study the properties of phase space and develop possible millitary and civilian applications. It is important to note that they were a significant division with considerable authority, with the chief researcher of the lab holding a millitary rank equivalent to a Vice Admiral of the Domain Navy.

Due to concerns of the dangerous nature of their research, the Phase Lab was deployed to the Persean Sector as to not raise any concerns, while being escorted by the Battlegroups XI to XVI. Unfortunately, this was when the Collapse had suddenly struck.
Upon losing connection with the gate network, the Phase Labs tried to enact the network failure protocol, however, a Space Anomaly denominated as a 'Phase Tsunami' swept over the Phase Lab fleets, dragging them all the way to the Orion-Perseus Abyss, causing them to lose all contact with the Battlegroups.

And so, the institute called 'Phase Labs of the Domain of Man' had become stranded in a dead-quiet abyss for years. Setting course to the nearest point of civilization, their trek through the Abyss lasted over 40 cycles without even the fringe point in sight. That is when the Vice Admiral Vasiliev arrived at a conclusion: In order to persevere through this journey, they had no option but to go through Cryosleep preservation. The selection was sorted by age: The young would enter cold sleep, while the elders would persevere to their last breath.
However, without a leader to command for generations to come, there was little to no hope of succeeding. At the time, Vice Admiral Vasiliev had one ace up his sleeve: An experimental device that would allow them to live for much longer, effectively overcoming mortality.
Details about what this 'device' might be remain classified to this day, but it is rumored that it wasn't something as simple as cybernetic implants.

However, things didn't go according to plan. In order for the device to work, one needed an exceptional synchronization rate. Neither Vasiliev or any of the other officers could achieve it.
When all hope was lost, in a last ditch effort, a child woken from Cryosleep was chosen. To the Phase Lab's surprise, this child was the sole candidate capable of synchronizing with the device. And so, they would naturally become the next Vice Admiral in line. The child's name was Eliza Lovelace.

Under Admiral Vasiliev's mentoring, Eliza Lovelace would come to lead the Phase Labs together all the way until C+90 where the fringe of the Persean Sector had finally come in sight.
At the time, the crew rejoiced, but as if the universe was setting them around a Thespian play, the Phase Labs had their first encounter with the Tri-Tachyon Drone Fleets: The Remnants of the AI Wars.
The Remnants, mistaking them as 'reinforcements' from the now-defunct Domain Battlegroup XIV due to the Phase Labs' IFF codes were immediately assaulted. Though the Phase Labs put on an admirable fight, they were ultimately overwhelmed.

Making the ultimate sacrifice, Vice Admiral Vasiliev, boarding an advanced prototype battleship, made his last stand, buying enough time for the rest of the fleet to escape, leaving Eliza as the sole surviving commander.
From there on, it was a painfully slow trek towards the core worlds. As they had run completely out of fuel, their journey took them 90 more cycles with many AI-Drones encounters inbetween.

Having finally come in close contact with civilization at around C+194, that is when the Phase Lab was met with the reality of the Sector: The Domain was no more. The gates lay dormant, civilization was in shambles, and there was seemingly no hope of re-establishing connection.
What little remained of the Phase Lab settled on a Tundra World now known as 'Research Site V.' Using it as a base of operations, they could settle and slowly rebuild what was lost.

Seeing them as a potential threat, The Persean League declared them to be enemies and invaders of the Sector, but under Eliza Lovelace's command, the Phase Labs remained steady over the next ten cycles, solidifying and establishing themselves as an independent faction of their own.

Introduction
A story about the fate of a domain military scientific institute studying phase space in the burning sector.
The Domain Phase Lab is a High-Tech faction centered around beam weaponry, lightning, motes, and surprisingly, phase technology.
The mod focuses on story content revolving around the faction. There are several quests that rewards the players with limited experimental weaponry and ships.
The Phase Labs are by nature pacifists who are more than eager to get to know others better.




Ships
Ships
Note: Only a few of the many ships are being shown. Ships are still subject to change.

DPL's ship designs mainly focuses around high-tech ships with a heavy focus towards energy weapons, as well as carriers to provide long-range support. Naturally, the Phase Labs also offers a wide variety of Phase Ships, some of which employs the use of certain gimmicks rather than providing any firepower themselves.
That said, the faction does not mainly rely on Phase Ships. The Phase Labs pursue the field of study of the many properties of P-Space, and their research bears fruit in the forms of weapons and systems.



Weapons
Weapons
The Bombardon (Built-in weapon for the Sarrusophone-class Capital), a long-range 'sniper' railgun.

The Phase Charge Lance, a common large beam weapon that creates motes upon impact.

The Lightning Projector, shoot powerful arcs of EMP lightning with rechargable ammo!

The Phase Rupture LPC, manipulate literal P-Space Phenomena as your tools of war.

...There are even some powerful prototype hulls and weapons out there, but they won't be so easy to obtain...

Lore
LoreOriginally a classified institute belonging to the Domain, The Phase Lab's main role is to study the properties of phase space and develop possible millitary and civilian applications. It is important to note that they were a significant division with considerable authority, with the chief researcher of the lab holding a millitary rank equivalent to a Vice Admiral of the Domain Navy.

Due to concerns of the dangerous nature of their research, the Phase Lab was deployed to the Persean Sector as to not raise any concerns, while being escorted by the Battlegroups XI to XVI. Unfortunately, this was when the Collapse had suddenly struck.
Upon losing connection with the gate network, the Phase Labs tried to enact the network failure protocol, however, a Space Anomaly denominated as a 'Phase Tsunami' swept over the Phase Lab fleets, dragging them all the way to the Orion-Perseus Abyss, causing them to lose all contact with the Battlegroups.

And so, the institute called 'Phase Labs of the Domain of Man' had become stranded in a dead-quiet abyss for years. Setting course to the nearest point of civilization, their trek through the Abyss lasted over 40 cycles without even the fringe point in sight. That is when the Vice Admiral Vasiliev arrived at a conclusion: In order to persevere through this journey, they had no option but to go through Cryosleep preservation. The selection was sorted by age: The young would enter cold sleep, while the elders would persevere to their last breath.
However, without a leader to command for generations to come, there was little to no hope of succeeding. At the time, Vice Admiral Vasiliev had one ace up his sleeve: An experimental device that would allow them to live for much longer, effectively overcoming mortality.
Details about what this 'device' might be remain classified to this day, but it is rumored that it wasn't something as simple as cybernetic implants.

However, things didn't go according to plan. In order for the device to work, one needed an exceptional synchronization rate. Neither Vasiliev or any of the other officers could achieve it.
When all hope was lost, in a last ditch effort, a child woken from Cryosleep was chosen. To the Phase Lab's surprise, this child was the sole candidate capable of synchronizing with the device. And so, they would naturally become the next Vice Admiral in line. The child's name was Eliza Lovelace.

Under Admiral Vasiliev's mentoring, Eliza Lovelace would come to lead the Phase Labs together all the way until C+90 where the fringe of the Persean Sector had finally come in sight.
At the time, the crew rejoiced, but as if the universe was setting them around a Thespian play, the Phase Labs had their first encounter with the Tri-Tachyon Drone Fleets: The Remnants of the AI Wars.
The Remnants, mistaking them as 'reinforcements' from the now-defunct Domain Battlegroup XIV due to the Phase Labs' IFF codes were immediately assaulted. Though the Phase Labs put on an admirable fight, they were ultimately overwhelmed.

Making the ultimate sacrifice, Vice Admiral Vasiliev, boarding an advanced prototype battleship, made his last stand, buying enough time for the rest of the fleet to escape, leaving Eliza as the sole surviving commander.
From there on, it was a painfully slow trek towards the core worlds. As they had run completely out of fuel, their journey took them 90 more cycles with many AI-Drones encounters inbetween.

Having finally come in close contact with civilization at around C+194, that is when the Phase Lab was met with the reality of the Sector: The Domain was no more. The gates lay dormant, civilization was in shambles, and there was seemingly no hope of re-establishing connection.
What little remained of the Phase Lab settled on a Tundra World now known as 'Research Site V.' Using it as a base of operations, they could settle and slowly rebuild what was lost.

Seeing them as a potential threat, The Persean League declared them to be enemies and invaders of the Sector, but under Eliza Lovelace's command, the Phase Labs remained steady over the next ten cycles, solidifying and establishing themselves as an independent faction of their own.

changelog.1.7.0:
Major Update
 Balance

 Rebalanced the vast majority of weapons, to be more or less on-par with vanilla.
 Reworked weapons that previously had 'shield-piercing' effects to new designs that don't break the game's balance.
 The Energy missiles (previously literal blue reapers) have been changed into a Salamander-like volley burst, instead of a single-hit weapon with massive strength that was too good at both breaking shields and armor.
 Adjusted the stats of the vast majority of ships to more closely resemble vanilla High-Tech. In general, DPL ships should now be more well-rounded and sturdier to endure some degree of punishment.
 Reworked the systems of many ships.
 Removed the built-in hullmods of the vast majority of ships that had them.
 Fighter spam in DPL is no longer as broken, with reduced fighter bays and balanced fighter LPCs.
 Removed Phase Carrier ships, instead replacing their design as a whole into specialized 'Anomaly' carrier ships.
 DPL ships that were underperforming now have more weapon mount variety, instead of being mono-energy.

 Graphics

 DPL ships now have their own color scheme instead of looking like blue high-tech.
 Reworked the design of many ships in general.
 Reworked some of the weapons' visuals.
 Added a new icon for Matcha.

 Campaign

 Revised the notoriously bad writing (Proofreader: Akii), alongside some new dialogue additions and changes in certain missions. The writing as a whole is still a work in progress.
 Reworked Colony Crisis to be more concise and reasonable.
 Temporarily removed 2 ships: Cornet, Whisper.
 Changes to story quests, such as the removal of time limits, to prevent the player from getting softlocked in their progress.
 Adjusted faction's music volume to not be as loud.
 Eliza and Ross are now slightly less heartfeltly touched by the player asking them about how was their day.
 Overall bug fixes and improvements.
